description: Heltec BMS 3S 25A protection board with balancing, for 3.7V lithium-ion cells; board marking BW-3SJH-25A

ports.label: B- / B1 / B2 / B+
ports.onlyNote: O carregador e as cargas vão em P+/P-; B+/B- é só para as células.
ports.src: cells-in-series 3; cell-chemistry (3,7 V/célula → 11,1 V; 12,6 V cheia); mínimo = 3 × corte de descarga de 2,5 V do battery-cell
ports.note: quatro fios para 3 células em série, incluindo os taps de balanceamento B1 e B2. A faixa cobre a excursão inteira do pack, do corte de descarga à carga completa — é justamente essa janela que a placa protege

pins.note: junção entre a célula 1 e a 2
junção entre a célula 2 e a 3

ports.label: P+ / P- (porta comum)
ports.note: porta COMUM: carga e carregador usam os mesmos dois terminais. É por aqui que o carregador deve entrar — ligá-lo em B+/B- passa por fora dos MOSFETs de proteção, que chaveiam a linha P-, e o pack fica sem proteção de sobrecarga

pins.note: os MOSFETs de proteção chaveiam esta linha

specs.cell-chemistry: lithium-ion, 3.7 V nominal per cell (12.6 V fully charged pack)
specs.balancing: passive balancing version (the board carries balance resistors); the active 1.2 A balancer described in the listing is a different option of the same advertisement

connections.B1: junction between cell 1 and cell 2 (3.7 V tap)
connections.B2: junction between cell 2 and cell 3 (7.4 V tap)
connections.P-: load / charger negative (the protection MOSFETs switch this line)

thresholds.note: the seller publishes a parameter table headed "3S40A LiFePO4" (3.7 V overcharge threshold, 2.1 V over-discharge, 40 A continuous), which belongs to a different board of the same listing and does NOT apply to this 3S 25A lithium-ion version - the real thresholds for this board are not published and must be measured

specs.note: a protection board, not a charger and not a battery gauge: it has no communication interface, does not report state of charge and does not balance-charge on its own - the pack still needs a proper CC-CV charger
